crossRefs.note: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was…
For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me…
who, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison, and secured their feet in the stocks.
Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
crossRefs.keyword: he was laid in iron. Heb. his soul came into iron

translations.web: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
translations.bsb: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
translations.kjv: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
translations.asv: His feet they hurt with fetters: He was laid in chains of iron,
